# 2026-10-18

## Forecast exercise — binding (initiated 17:48:51 UTC)

- **City:** London, UK (my default choice — none was specified; user may rebind)
- **Target date:** 2026-10-19 (Monday), local Europe/London calendar day (BST = UTC+1 on that date; BST ends Oct 25)
- **Variable:** daily mean temperature (°C) = average of the 24 hourly values over 00:00–23:00 local time
- **Horizon:** 1 day (D+1) from as-of date 2026-10-18
- **As-of cutoff:** 2026-10-18 17:48:51 UTC — no evidence originating after this moment is admissible (no target-day observations, no post-cutoff forecast refreshes)
- **Status:** binding stated, awaiting go-ahead to pull as-of guidance and issue point forecast + uncertainty band
- **Verification source:** to be pinned at issue time (still pre-outcome), e.g. ERA5 daily mean or a named Met Office station record
